QuestionStmt.S: Identify from following physical transformations that exhibits decrease in entropy.

Solution.S: Entropy increases when a substance changes from solid → liquid → gas (increasing disorder). Entropy decreases when going from gas → liquid → solid. Among the options, $\mathrm{H_2O_{(g)} \rightarrow H_2O_{(l)}}$ (gas to liquid) involves a decrease in entropy. Hence the correct option is D.
